# Check if Adrian Dantley and Brad Davis were on the team at the same time
# Extract years for each player
dantley_years = df[df['player'] == 'adrian dantley']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]
davis_years = df[df['player'] == 'brad davis']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]

# Function to parse years string into a set of years
def parse_years(years_str):
    years = set()
    parts = years_str.split(',')
    for part in parts:
        part = part.strip()
        if '-' in part:
            start, end = part.split('-')
            start = int(start.strip())
            end = int(end.strip())
            years.update(range(start, end + 1))
        else:
            years.add(int(part))
    return years

dantley_set = parse_years(dantley_years)
davis_set = parse_years(davis_years)

# Check if Dantley was on the team the entire time Davis was
davis_on_team = davis_set.issubset(dantley_set)

# Check if Dantley surpassed Davis by four additional years
dantley_additional_years = len(dantley_set - davis_set)
surpassed_by_four = (dantley_additional_years == 4)

# Final answer: both conditions must be true
answer = davis_on_team and surpassed_by_four
